Workshop 1 · Practice problems

Regex, precision and recall

Do these on paper with no laptop, the way the exam works. Total 30 marks; aim for about 40 minutes. Check your regex answers on regex101.com (Python flavour) only after you have written them down.

Print
  1. [2]

    Indian vehicle registration numbers look like KA 20 AB 1234 or KA20AB1234: two capital letters (state), two digits (district), one or two capital letters (series), and four digits, with optional single spaces between the parts. Write a regex that matches both forms.

  2. [3]

    Which of the following strings contain a match for \b\d{1,2}\s?kg\b? For each one that does not, say why in a few words.
    (a) 7 kg   (b) 7kg   (c) 17 kg bag   (d) 107 kg   (e) 7 kgs   (f) 7 Kg

  3. [2]

    What does this return?

    re.findall(r"(\d+)\s(day|week)s?", "leaked after 2 weeks, replaced after 10 days")
  4. [2]

    For the string <b>Fast</b> delivery, what does re.findall return with the pattern <.*>, and what does it return with <.*?>? Explain the difference in one line.

  5. [3]

    A marketing analyst uses \d+% to pull discount percentages from competitor ads. Give three realistic strings where it goes wrong. Label each one as a false positive or a false negative, and propose an improved pattern.

  6. [4]

    A regex flags 120 support tickets as "late delivery" complaints. A manual check finds that 90 of them really are. An audit of all tickets finds 150 late-delivery complaints in total. (a) Compute precision, recall and F1. (b) In one line, what does this mean for a weekly "late delivery" count shown to the COO?

  7. [3]

    You have two PII redactors. A has precision 0.99 and recall 0.90. B has precision 0.85 and recall 0.99. (a) Which would you use before sharing tickets with an outside vendor? (b) Which would you use to put tickets in a queue for expensive human review? Justify each answer in one line.

  8. [3]

    A GSTIN has 15 characters: a 2-digit state code, then a 10-character PAN (5 capital letters, 4 digits, 1 capital letter), then 1 entity character (a digit 1–9 or a capital letter), then the letter Z, then 1 check character (a digit or a capital letter). Example: 29ABCDE1234F1Z5. Write a regex for it.

  9. [4]

    A bank wants to extract loan amounts from customer emails. It sees: ₹5 lakh, 5,00,000, Rs 12,50,000, Rs 5L, and five lakhs. (a) Write a regex for numbers in the Indian lakh grouping (5,00,000, 12,50,000, 1,00,00,000). (b) Which of the five forms is hardest for regex, and why?

  10. [4]

    Your team built a regex that detects churn intent in customer chats ("cancel", "switch to", "close my account") and reports F1 = 0.70. Before approving deployment, write two questions you would ask the team. Link each question to the cost of false positives or false negatives in this business.

Answers will be released on the Workshop 1 page after class.
